A price curve, not a contact form

Every structure is priced against the same model: board, size, print, finish and quantity. Change the quantity and the unit price moves — so you can see where the break-even sits before you commit to a tooling cost.

MOQ 500 pieces per design for printed boxes. Unprinted stock ships from 100 pieces.
How much does a custom box cost?

At 500 pieces, a 9.5×9.5×4 cm rigid jewelry box is about $2.83 per unit and a 30×22×12 cm printed mailer box about $2.48. The unit price drops as quantity goes up — the quote builder shows the full curve for your size.
Stock styles ship in 1–15 days. Printed custom orders are scheduled after sample approval, usually 7–30 days depending on structure and finishing.
Do you handle the whole supply chain?
We coordinate sampling, production, inspection and freight with vetted suppliers, and charge an 8–15% sourcing fee on the order value.
Shenzhen, China. DDP to the US and EU is standard; FOB is available if you consolidate.
